responsibility: Implements HIR-level Rust pattern analysis used to validate match expressions for exhaustiveness, and to traverse crate bodies looking for match sites to check. Beyond the general full-HIR visitor plumbing in PatternChecker, this file owns lowering HIR patterns into a deconstructed constructor-based representation, specialization of pattern matrices by enum/struct/reference constructors, recursive computation of witness patterns for uncovered cases, and emission of non-exhaustive-match diagnostics that describe which scrutinee shapes are not covered.
same_name_distinction: Within the rust-hir-pattern-analysis pair, this .cc file implements the match-pattern analysis machinery itself—HIR traversal, pattern lowering, matrix specialization, witness computation, and diagnostic emission—whereas the header declares the visitor entry points and the supporting analysis data structures.
